entry: Repackager.repackage → JarFile manifest and named entry

questions.history: Package the single CycloneDX fixture under the WAR classes path.
questions.prediction: The PR reports the parent WAR contains the file but omits both attributes. On the merge expect `Sbom-Format=CycloneDX` and `Sbom-Location=WEB-INF/classes/META-INF/sbom/application.cdx.json`, resolving to the supplied bytes.
questions.basis: The physical WAR path follows the classes layout. The Maven integration fixture asserts the entry and both attributes.
questions.refutation: Missing or wrong attributes, a dangling manifest path, or bytes different from the supplied fixture.

questions.history: Use the existing packager JAR fixture with a source entry at `META-INF/sbom/application.cdx.json` and `Layouts.Jar`. Inspect the recorded source location as the shared packager test does.
questions.prediction: On both revisions the format attribute should equal `CycloneDX` and the location attribute should equal `META-INF/sbom/application.cdx.json` in the fixture’s generated manifest.
questions.basis: The root-level discovery rule remains in the landed implementation and the shared JAR test asserts these values.
questions.refutation: Either attribute disappears or the WAR prefix appears in this JAR fixture.

questions.history: In the WAR retain the one recognized SBOM. Add an ordinary resource named `other/application.cdx.json` with different bytes and put it earlier in the archive.
questions.prediction: On the merge the location should still select the file under `WEB-INF/classes/META-INF/sbom/`. Reading its entry must yield the original marker, independent of the decoy’s position.
questions.basis: The file suffix alone is insufficient; the recognized SBOM directory and the physical entry named by the manifest determine the selection.
questions.refutation: The decoy is advertised or returned, the manifest omits the SBOM, or its value cannot be looked up in the WAR.
